goal: Be comfortable at salsa socials — know enough techniques, combine them, lead confidently

phases.name: Foundation
phases.why: The basic is EVERYTHING. If your timing is off, nothing works. Drill the count until it's automatic — 1-2-3, 5-6-7 — so you can think about leading, not counting.

practice_sessions.drill: Stand in front of a mirror. Count out loud: 1-2-3, 5-6-7. Back on left on 1. Do 50 reps until you stop thinking about your feet.
20 basics, then practice the turn signal: lift hand on 1. Visualize the follower turning. Do 10 turns each direction (air partner is fine).
Put on a slow salsa song. Do basics for 8 bars, then an inside turn. Repeat. Don't rush — stay on the 2.

practice_sessions.focus: Class #2 — Basic step, right turn, hand holds, leader turn
practice_sessions.drill: Attended class. Instructor covered: basic step (quick-quick-slow, knees up), partner hand hold (palms up/over, 2 fingers not thumbs), right turn footwork (forward-forward-turn, stay on the line, spotting), leader signaling (one hand, lift on second bar), leader's own right turn (left hand down, rotate fingers, switch hand).
practice_sessions.notes: Class #2 attended. Full transcript ingested. 12 teaching points extracted.

practice_sessions.focus: Post-class: Basic step rhythm + right turn footwork (solo)
practice_sessions.drill:
WARM UP (5 min):
- 20 basics counting 'quick, quick, slow' out loud. Knees UP — 'up, up, up' not flat.
- Think drum beat: every foot hit = a beat.

RIGHT TURN FOOTWORK (10 min):
- 10 right turns solo: forward, forward, turn RIGHT. Land on right foot.
- KEY: Stay on the line — turn right but DON'T drift forward. Go right, back to center.
- After each turn, immediately basic: 'ta-ta-po' (back, back, forward).
- Full pattern: right turn → basic → right turn → basic. 10 reps.

SPOTTING (5 min):
- Pick a target on the wall. Eyes stay on it. Turn, bring head back to target.
- Do 10 right turns focusing ONLY on spotting. Don't worry about feet for these.

COOL DOWN:
- 10 basics with music, slow song. Just feel the rhythm.

BASICS WITH INTENT (5 min):
- 20 basics. On each one, say the count: 'back, back, forward, forward, forward, back' (leader timing).
- Make sure you're doing PART 2 FIRST as the leader.

LEADER SIGNAL DRILL (10 min):
- Air partner. Hold left hand up, 2 fingers (middle + ring, Spider-Man grip).
- Pattern: 1 basic → LIFT hand on second bar (this is the signal) → follower turns → 1 basic.
- Do 15 reps. Focus: the lift happens on count 1 of the second bar.
- Your forward does NOT change — you keep doing your basic while she turns.

HAND FLIP (5 min):
- Slow motion: cuff around fingers → flip wrist back as she turns → flip back down.
- 10 reps, just the hand movement. Then combine with the full signal drill.

LEADER'S OWN TURN (5 min):
- Forward, forward, turn. Left hand comes DOWN.
- Turn around, fingers rotate behind back, switch hand.
- 10 reps solo. Follower just does basic (imagine it).

practice_sessions.focus: Full combo with music — basic + right turn + leader turn
practice_sessions.drill:
SLOW SONG (15 min total):
- Put on a slow salsa song.
- Do 4 bars of basic.
- Right turn → basic.
- 4 more bars of basic.
- Leader's own turn → basic.
- Repeat the whole pattern for the full song.

GOAL: Never break timing. If you lose the count, stop, find the 1, restart.

CHECKLIST — ask yourself after each song:
- Was I on 'quick, quick, slow' the whole time?
- Did I stay on the line during turns?
- Did I spot a target?
- Was my hand hold relaxed (2 fingers, no death grip)?

Do 3 songs. If you nail all 3, you're ready for the next class.

THIS IS YOUR PRE-CLASS WARMUP (do before every class going forward):

1. 20 basics — 'quick, quick, slow', knees up (2 min)
2. 10 right turns solo — stay on the line, spot target (2 min)
3. 10 leader signals with air partner — lift on second bar (3 min)
4. 5 leader's own turns — left hand down, rotate, switch (2 min)
5. 1 slow song combining everything freely (3 min)

Total: ~12 min. If anything feels shaky, double the reps on that one.

phases.name: Cross Body Lead
phases.why: The cross body lead is how you move the follower from one side to the other. It's the second most important move after the basic — almost everything builds on it.

practice_sessions.drill: Learn the footwork: open on 1-2-3, she crosses on 5-6-7. Practice solo — step to the side to open the slot, then step back.
4 basics → cross body lead → 4 basics → cross body lead. Repeat 10 times.
Basic → CBL → inside turn → basic → CBL. You now have a 3-move vocabulary — combine them freely.
Slow song. Mix basic, CBL, inside turn randomly. Goal: never break timing, smooth transitions.
